chapters.title: The State of Liberation While Living

verses.sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तः स विज्ञेयो यः स्थितः प्रकृतेः परम् ।
न सुखं न च दुःखं वा कर्तव्यं नास्ति किञ्चन ॥
verses.translation: He is known as liberated while living who is established beyond material nature. There is no happiness nor sorrow, nor any duty remaining for him.

verses.sanskrit:
चिन्मात्रोऽहं सदा शुद्धः बुद्ध्यादिव्यर्तजो ध्रुवः ।
सत्यानन्दस्वरूपोऽहम् अहमेवाहमव्ययः ॥
verses.translation: I am pure consciousness, ever pure, free from intellect and changes, eternal. I am of the nature of truth and bliss — I alone am the imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मैवेदं जगत्सर्वमात्मनोऽन्यन्न किञ्चन ।
मृदो यथा पृथक्भूताः कल्पनायां घटादयः ॥
verses.translation: This entire universe is the Self alone; nothing other than the Self exists. Just as pots and other objects are imagined as separate from clay, so too are individual forms from Brahman.
